topic: big and small, up and down (opposites)
title: Up Down Fun
yt_description:
Join Pip, Lulu, and Bo as they learn about opposites like big and small, up and down. This song teaches toddlers to recognize and understand these basic concepts. With simple and repetitive lyrics, your child will have fun singing along and learning.

🎵 Up Down Fun

Hello friends
Let's play today
Up and down

Big balloon
Up so high
Small ball down

Up and down
Big and small
Fun for all

Up and down
Big and small
Fun for all

Bye friends
Play again
Up and down
